page_title: WER 3-3 EIN | Werder Bremen v Eintracht Frankfurt 16/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Benjamin Brand has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is given a yellow card.
90+5' 3 - 3 Referee Benjamin Brand points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Eintracht Frankfurt players celebrate.
90+5' It’s in! Goal for Eintracht Frankfurt, but surely the ball went out of play in the lead up. Referee Benjamin Brand wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
90+5' GOAL! Wait, the goal by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not going to count as the ball ran out of play during the build up.
90+1' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' That's the end of the game for Justin Njinmah, who is replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
88' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but Kaua Santos comes off his line to gather the ball.
88' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' The foul by Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benjamin Brand.
84' The current number of corner kicks is 4:1.
83' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Fares Chaibi will be replaced by Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' Substitution. Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Ritsu Doan.
81' 3 - 2 Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.

78' 2 - 2 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header inside the right post. An incredible long-range header!
78' A yellow card for a tackle by Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt). Benjamin Brand doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

77' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Grull leaves the pitch and Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) comes on.

75' Werder Bremen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
73' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
71' PENALTY APPEAL after Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

68' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
68' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
66' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is punished with the yellow card.
65' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Mahmoud Dahoud.
65' The referee signals a substitution. Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Isaac Schmidt.
63' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
61' The game is interrupted now, Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
56' 1 - 2 Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!

54' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
52' Substitution. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) on for Rasmus Kristensen.
52' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
51' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mio Backhaus, who smothers the ball.
50' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Werder Bremen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
47' Chance! Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Kaua Santos is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+6' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Werder Bremen, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

45+5' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
45+5' The free kick is taken by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), but ball is cleared.

45+4' It's a free kick to Werder Bremen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here. Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.

45+2' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
42' Werder Bremen force a corner. They send men into the box.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen). Werder Bremen earn a corner.
39' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

38' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Werder Bremen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
37' The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen win a corner kick.
35' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
34' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
30' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
29' 1 - 1 Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) scores as he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a perfect strike that goes behind the goalkeeper.
27' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

24' A dangerous towering header by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
23' The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
21' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
20' That was close by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
18' Wonderful movement by Werder Bremen. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
18' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kaua Santos intercepts the ball.
17' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
15' Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
12' Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' The referee awards a corner and Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) goes over to take it.
11' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
8' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' Flag goes up against Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
4' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

1' 0 - 1 Goal Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt)! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) was put through by Nathaniel Brown and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Benjamin Brand will officiate today.
